newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER FALLS, VOLUME RISES.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER FALLS, VOLUME RISES.

text.p: Turnover fell in rising volume at Thursday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
Total turnover fell to 80,700 denars from 86,915 denars with 30 shares changing hands, up from 16 units at the previous trading on Tuesday.
Investbanka sold 30 stocks at 2,690 denars on the third floor, unchanged from last trading and above par of 2,664 denars.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades twice a week.
